title: Domain E Replacement Specification — Section E Internal Controls

quantity.description: 1 replacement item per DL-012 clone group. Consolidate from 4 template variants (1 seed + 3 company-name-rotated clones) to 1 unique, pedagogically distinct item per topic.
38 retained seeds across Packs C/D Section E. Full CAQS §1.6 certification pipeline.

antiInflationRules: Definition-recall items are Easy, not Moderate (DL-031 prevention)
Single-step application items are Moderate, not Difficult
Multi-step analysis items are Difficult, not Hard
DifficultyScore must match actual cognitive demand of the item, not the LOS verb alone
difficultyTargets.benchmark: Pack B Section E difficulty distribution

accuracyRequirements: CognitiveLevel must be verified against Bloom's taxonomy by independent reviewer
No mismatch between LOS verb and CognitiveLevel
Application items must present novel scenarios, not recall

blueprintTargets.losPrecisionRequirement: LOSTag must reference a specific CSO LOS (e.g., 'E.1.e Segregation of duties') not a generic section label ('E. Internal controls'). Verified against IMA CMA Part 1 Content Specification Outline.

requiredElements: Principle or framework citation (COSO, SOX, GAAS)
Why the correct answer is correct (substantive reasoning)
Common exam trap or misconception identified

perDistractor.requirement: Choice-specific — explains WHY this specific choice is wrong. References the specific concept, framework, or calculation error that would lead to this choice.

explanationWrong.dl008Compliance: EW[CorrectChoice] must be empty string. Non-negotiable.

distractors.plausibility: Must represent a genuine misconception, calculation error, or plausible alternative — not an obviously wrong throwaway
distractors.specificity: Each distractor must be topic-specific and draw from common CMA exam traps
distractors.misconceptionBasis: Derived from documented learner errors, not invented for the item

stem.clarity: Unambiguous. Contains all data needed to answer. No trick wording.
stem.completeness: No hidden assumptions. All values explicitly stated.
stem.fairness: Tests knowledge of the topic, not reading comprehension or esoteric terminology

metadata.topics: Precise — specific CSO LOS, not generic section label
metadata.productionStatus: Draft → Technical Review → Blueprint Review → QA Review → Certification Candidate

antiPatterns.prevention: Never use template text. All explanations must be original.
EW at CorrectChoice index must always be empty.
Verify EC matches stem topic before submission.

replacementStrategy.cloneGroupConsolidation: Each clone group (1 seed + 3 rotated clones) → 1 replacement item. This collapses 129 archived clones into 43 unique items covering the same topics.
replacementStrategy.answerRotation: Use different CorrectChoice letter than original seed to prevent answer memorization by learners who encountered the seed previously.
replacementStrategy.ewAuthoring: Author EC and all 3 EW fields during item creation — do not defer to separate EW pass. This prevents DL-021/026 empty-slot defects.

benchmark.reason: 100% certified. Gold standard for Section E quality. All items have substantive EC (400+ chars), choice-specific EW, and precise metadata.

governanceCompliance.dl008: EW[CorrectChoice] = empty — verified at Technical Review gate
governanceCompliance.dl013: No template boilerplate — verified at Technical Review gate
governanceCompliance.dl026: All non-CC EW slots non-empty — verified at Technical Review gate
governanceCompliance.dl031: DifficultyScore realistic — verified at Blueprint Review gate
governanceCompliance.caqs16: Six-dimension verification (Correctness, Precision, Difficulty, Distractor, Blueprint, Relevance) — HIGH confidence required for Certification Candidate
